create_atari_preprocessing_wrapper: create an AtariPreprocessing wrapper around a Gym Atari environment with frame skipping and grayscale
reset_atari_environment_with_noops: reset the Atari environment with random no-ops applied before the first observation
step_atari_with_frame_skip: step the Atari environment with frame skipping, max pooling, and reward accumulation
fetch_grayscale_observation: fetch a grayscale screen observation directly from the ALE into a numpy buffer
pool_and_resize_frames: pool two grayscale frames via max pooling and resize to 84x84 for DQN input
